add_paragraph: Sofia was a postdoc in the lab until 2021, working on sediment microbial communities and how quickly they turn over organic carbon in cold water.
She now leads a group at the Max Planck Institute for Marine Microbiology in Bremen, where the questions have followed her from soil to seafloor.
The ==sediment coring protocol== she wrote here is still in use on both coasts.
